profiles.profile_notes: Generic starting values, not a certified sprayer specification. The 1.4 mm nozzle, 150-200 mm working distance and 1.7 bar air starting pressure are based on manufacturer guidance examples. The 74 degree equivalent fan angle is estimated from a 275-330 mm fan width at 200 mm. Nozzle length is an illustrative placeholder. Confirm all settings against the actual sprayer and coating.
